mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and can increase colchicine levels; prochlorperazine may also enhance colchicine's gastrointestinal and neuromuscular effects.
action: Monitor for colchicine toxicity signs (diarrhea, myopathy, neuropathy); consider dose reduction of colchicine or use alternative antiemetic if colchicine dose cannot be adjusted.
